title: NEL (U+0085) in metric
reason: U+0085 is a C1 control that PyYAML does not round-trip; a reference implementation MUST reject it rather than lock a non-portable hash.

title: Line Separator (U+2028) in claim_id
reason: U+2028 canonicalizes inconsistently across YAML engines and JS string contexts; MUST be rejected.

title: Paragraph Separator (U+2029) in producer.id
reason: U+2029 is a non-portable line/paragraph separator; MUST be rejected.

title: BOM (U+FEFF) in dataset.id
reason: A zero-width BOM is invisible and shifts canonical bytes; MUST be rejected.

title: DEL (U+007F) in metric
reason: U+007F is a C0-adjacent control character; MUST be rejected.

title: NUL (U+0000) in claim_id
reason: An embedded null byte is a C0 control; MUST be rejected.

title: C1 control (U+009F) in producer.id
reason: U+009F is a C1 control in the U+0080-U+009F band; MUST be rejected.

title: missing required field (seed)
reason: All 9 required fields must be present; a missing field MUST be rejected, not silently hashed.

title: dataset.hash not 64 lowercase hex
reason: dataset.hash is fixed at 64 lowercase hex chars; a malformed hash MUST be rejected.
expect: dataset.hash must be 64 lowercase hex chars

title: invalid comparator
reason: comparator must be one of >=,<=,>,<,==; anything else MUST be rejected.

title: unknown version string
reason: version must be prml/0.1 or prml/0.2; an unknown version MUST be rejected.

title: threshold is not a number
reason: threshold must be a finite number; a string threshold MUST be rejected.
expect: threshold must be a finite number

title: Line Separator (U+2028) in a top-level KEY name
reason: A forbidden char in a key canonicalizes non-portably exactly as in a value; MUST be rejected, not silently hashed.

title: Line Separator (U+2028) in a nested KEY name (dataset)
reason: Nested keys are scanned too; a forbidden char in dataset.<key> MUST be rejected.

title: Non-finite threshold (.inf) — a bar no observation can fail
reason: An infinite threshold locks and verifies cleanly while asserting nothing: `<= .inf` passes for every observation. The manifest is cryptographically sound and epistemically empty, so it MUST be rejected at lock time.
expect: threshold must be a finite number

title: Duplicate key — the read manifest and the hashed manifest differ
reason: Mainstream YAML and JSON loaders resolve a repeated key last-wins with no diagnostic, so a reader and the hash can bind different values. RFC 7493 (I-JSON) 2.3 prohibits duplicate names for this reason; PRML MUST reject.

title: String not in Unicode NFC (NFD spelling of the same text)
reason: NFC and NFD spellings of the same name are identical to a reader and different bytes to SHA-256, so the same claim would lock to two hashes depending on the authoring platform. Non-NFC input MUST be rejected, not silently normalized: rewriting it would change the bytes the author believes they locked.

title: Duplicate name in JSON input (RFC 7493 §2.3)
reason: Same defect as RJ-017 through the JSON door. Most JSON parsers are silently last-wins, so an impl that only reads JSON must reject duplicates explicitly.

title: String not in Unicode NFC, JSON input
reason: Same defect as RJ-018 through the JSON door, so JSON-only impls are covered.
